text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby. Yaeno 
Muteki exchanges greetings with Mejiro 
Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both rivals were few in words. The tension 
was so suffocating that neither could even 
breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki recalled their obsession with 
the Derby. Precisely because they had 
pushed each other to grow, she felt a 
burning desire to win.
